summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of FeGrro Construction Worker Hours Logging App completed. All 33 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features: admin login, hours table with Zaliczki/Kary columns, modals, Brygadzisci tab with delete button, Narzedzia tab with 3 sync buttons (green/orange/red), public worker links, PWA manifest. App is fully functional.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthenticated requests - acceptable behavior but inconsistent with REST conventions
